 9. Compare the prescribed diet to your calculation of energy
and protein requirements.
Calculation
For a 0 to <3 month infant recommended energy is 
120 (124–95) kcal/kg and protein is 3.50–3.00 g/kg.
Infant weighs 5.5 lb or 2.75 kg
Calculated energy needs: 2.75 kg  120 kcal/kg  330 kcal
or: 2.75 kg  the range (95–124 kcal/kg)  261.25–341 kcal
Calculated protein needs: 2.75 kg  3.00–3.50 g/kg 
8.25–9.625 g protein
